# Panel H

## Fig2H

```{r fig2h, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# ============================================================
# 3-group metabolomics Venn + outer ring bars from raw data
# - metadata:      Sample_Metadata_3groups.csv
# - metabolomics:  Q2.xlsx (sheet = "sample")
#
# Groups:
#   A = GR
#   B = MR
#   C = MR+Phage cocktail
#
# Main outputs:
#   results_3group_metabolite_venn_ringbars/
#     01_input_checks/
#     02_differential/
#     03_venn_sets/
#     04_plot/
#
# Plot design:
#   - Center: 2-set Venn (GR vs MR ; MR+Phage cocktail vs MR)
#   - Outer ring bars:
#       outer track = GR vs MR
#       inner track = MR+Phage cocktail vs MR
#   - only regions: use venn-set colors
#   - shared region: each shared metabolite gets its own distinct color
#   - Outward  = higher in GR / MR+Phage cocktail
#   - Inward   = lower in GR / MR+Phage cocktail
#   - Bar length = |log2FC|
# ============================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# -----------------------------
# user parameters
# -----------------------------
METADATA_FILE      <- "Sample_Metadata_3groups.csv"
METABOLOMICS_FILE  <- "Q2.xlsx"
METABOLOMICS_SHEET <- "sample"

OUTDIR <- "results_3group_metabolite_venn_ringbars"

GROUP_LEVELS <- c("GR", "MR", "MR+Phage cocktail")

# metabolite differential cutoffs for set membership
METAB_AB_FDR_CUT <- 0.20   # GR vs MR
METAB_CB_FDR_CUT <- 0.20   # MR+Phage cocktail vs MR

# only-region colors = venn circle colors
AONLY_COLOR <- "#7CAE00"   # GR vs MR only
BONLY_COLOR <- "#00BFC4"   # MR+Phage cocktail vs MR only

# bar length scaling
BAR_MAX_LEN_OUTER <- 0.32
BAR_MAX_LEN_INNER <- 0.24

# angular ranges (degrees) for the 3 Venn regions around the outside
# left = A only ; top = shared ; right = B only
ANGLE_RANGE_AONLY  <- c(140, 240)
ANGLE_RANGE_SHARED <- c(55, 125)
ANGLE_RANGE_BONLY  <- c(-40, 40)

# plot geometry
VENN_LEFT_X   <- -0.48
VENN_RIGHT_X  <-  0.48
VENN_CENTER_Y <-  0.00
VENN_RADIUS   <-  0.78

OUTER_TRACK_BASE <- 1.72
INNER_TRACK_BASE <- 1.48

POLY_N <- 45

# -----------------------------
# helpers
# -----------------------------
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "01_input_checks"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "02_differential"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "03_venn_sets"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "04_plot"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

msg <- function(...) {
  cat(sprintf("[%s] ", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")), ..., "\n")
}

stop_if_missing_file <- function(x) {
  if (!file.exists(x)) stop("File not found: ", x)
}

safe_write_csv <- function(x, file) {
  readr::write_csv(x, file, na = "")
}

lsd_p <- function(mean1, mean2, n1, n2, mse, df_res) {
  if (any(is.na(c(mean1, mean2, n1, n2, mse, df_res))) ||
      n1 < 2 || n2 < 2 || mse <= 0 || df_res <= 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  tval <- (mean1 - mean2) / sqrt(mse * (1 / n1 + 1 / n2))
  2 * stats::pt(abs(tval), df = df_res, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

safe_neglog10 <- function(x, floor = 1e-300) {
  -log10(pmax(x, floor, na.rm = TRUE))
}

rescale_range <- function(x, to = c(0, 1), from = NULL) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  if (length(x) == 0) return(numeric(0))
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(rep(mean(to), length(x)))
  if (is.null(from)) from <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!all(is.finite(from)) || diff(from) == 0) return(rep(mean(to), length(x)))
  scaled <- (x - from[1]) / diff(from)
  to[1] + scaled * diff(to)
}

make_distinct_colors <- function(n) {
  if (n <= 0) return(character(0))
  hues <- seq(15, 375, length.out = n + 1)[1:n]
  grDevices::hcl(h = hues, c = 95, l = 65)
}

make_circle_df <- function(cx, cy, r, n = 360) {
  theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n)
  tibble::tibble(
    x = cx + r * cos(theta),
    y = cy + r * sin(theta)
  )
}

sector_polygon <- function(theta1_deg, theta2_deg, r_inner, r_outer, n = 40) {
  th1 <- theta1_deg * pi / 180
  th2 <- theta2_deg * pi / 180
  th_outer <- seq(th1, th2, length.out = n)
  th_inner <- seq(th2, th1, length.out = n)

  tibble::tibble(
    x = c(r_outer * cos(th_outer), r_inner * cos(th_inner)),
    y = c(r_outer * sin(th_outer), r_inner * sin(th_inner))
  )
}

assign_angles <- function(df_region, theta_start_deg, theta_end_deg) {
  n <- nrow(df_region)
  if (n == 0) return(df_region)

  if (n == 1) {
    center_deg <- mean(c(theta_start_deg, theta_end_deg))
    width_deg  <- min(abs(theta_end_deg - theta_start_deg) * 0.55, 10)
    df_region$theta_center_deg <- center_deg
    df_region$theta_min_deg <- center_deg - width_deg / 2
    df_region$theta_max_deg <- center_deg + width_deg / 2
    return(df_region)
  }

  centers <- seq(theta_start_deg, theta_end_deg, length.out = n + 2)[2:(n + 1)]
  gap <- abs(diff(range(theta_start_deg, theta_end_deg))) / (n + 1)
  width_deg <- min(gap * 0.65, 9)

  df_region$theta_center_deg <- centers
  df_region$theta_min_deg <- centers - width_deg / 2
  df_region$theta_max_deg <- centers + width_deg / 2
  df_region
}

build_ring_poly <- function(plot_tbl, track = c("outer", "inner"), max_abs_fc) {
  track <- match.arg(track)

  if (nrow(plot_tbl) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())

  base_radius <- if (track == "outer") OUTER_TRACK_BASE else INNER_TRACK_BASE
  max_len     <- if (track == "outer") BAR_MAX_LEN_OUTER else BAR_MAX_LEN_INNER
  comp_col    <- if (track == "outer") "log2FC_A_vs_B" else "log2FC_C_vs_B"

  df_use <- plot_tbl %>%
    filter(
      (track == "outer" & venn_region %in% c("GR_vs_MR_only", "Shared")) |
        (track == "inner" & venn_region %in% c("Phage_vs_MR_only", "Shared"))
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      comp_value = .data[[comp_col]],
      comp_abs   = abs(comp_value),
      bar_len    = ifelse(
        is.na(comp_abs) | max_abs_fc <= 0,
        0,
        comp_abs / max_abs_fc * max_len
      ),
      direction  = case_when(
        is.na(comp_value) ~ "missing",
        comp_value > 0 ~ "outward",
        comp_value < 0 ~ "inward",
        TRUE ~ "flat"
      )
    )

  poly_list <- vector("list", nrow(df_use))
  idx <- 1L

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_use))) {
    rr <- df_use[i, ]

    if (is.na(rr$bar_len) || rr$bar_len <= 0) next

    if (rr$direction == "outward") {
      r_in  <- base_radius
      r_out <- base_radius + rr$bar_len
    } else if (rr$direction == "inward") {
      r_in  <- base_radius - rr$bar_len
      r_out <- base_radius
    } else {
      next
    }

    poly_df <- sector_polygon(
      theta1_deg = rr$theta_min_deg,
      theta2_deg = rr$theta_max_deg,
      r_inner = r_in,
      r_outer = r_out,
      n = POLY_N
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        metabolite = rr$metabolite,
        region = rr$venn_region,
        comparison = ifelse(track == "outer", "GR vs MR", "MR+Phage cocktail vs MR"),
        direction = rr$direction,
        value = rr$comp_value,
        abs_value = rr$comp_abs,
        color = rr$color,
        poly_id = paste(track, rr$metabolite, sep = "__")
      )

    poly_list[[idx]] <- poly_df
    idx <- idx + 1L
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(poly_list)
}

wrap_name <- function(x, width = 26) {
  stringr::str_wrap(x, width = width)
}

# -----------------------------
# 1. read metadata
# -----------------------------
msg("Reading metadata...")
stop_if_missing_file(METADATA_FILE)
meta <- readr::read_csv(METADATA_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)

required_meta_cols <- c("sample", "group")
if (!all(required_meta_cols %in% colnames(meta))) {
  stop("Metadata must contain columns: sample, group")
}

meta <- meta %>%
  filter(group %in% GROUP_LEVELS) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = GROUP_LEVELS)) %>%
  arrange(group, sample)

samples_keep <- meta$sample
safe_write_csv(meta, file.path(OUTDIR, "01_input_checks", "metadata_used.csv"))

msg("Metadata samples: ", length(samples_keep))

# -----------------------------
# 2. read metabolomics raw table
# -----------------------------
msg("Reading metabolomics raw table...")
stop_if_missing_file(METABOLOMICS_FILE)
met_raw <- readxl::read_excel(METABOLOMICS_FILE, sheet = METABOLOMICS_SHEET)
met_raw <- as.data.frame(met_raw)

required_met_cols <- c("Compound Name (nmol/g)", samples_keep)
if (!all(required_met_cols %in% colnames(met_raw))) {
  stop("Metabolomics table is missing required columns in sheet '", METABOLOMICS_SHEET, "'.")
}

meta_cols_met <- intersect(
  c("中文名称", "CAS", "Formula", "Pubchem.ID", "HMDB", "KEGG", "Class", "分类", "Average Molecular Weight"),
  colnames(met_raw)
)

met_long <- met_raw %>%
  select(all_of(c("Compound Name (nmol/g)", meta_cols_met, samples_keep))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(samples_keep), names_to = "sample", values_to = "value_raw") %>%
  mutate(
    metabolite = as.character(`Compound Name (nmol/g)`),
    value_raw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value_raw))
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample") %>%
  filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(metabolite), metabolite != "")

half_min_tbl <- met_long %>%
  group_by(metabolite) %>%
  summarise(
    min_pos = suppressWarnings(min(value_raw[value_raw > 0], na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    min_pos = ifelse(is.infinite(min_pos), NA_real_, min_pos),
    half_min = min_pos / 2
  )

met_long2 <- met_long %>%
  left_join(half_min_tbl, by = "metabolite") %>%
  mutate(
    value_imp = case_when(
      is.na(value_raw) ~ NA_real_,
      value_raw > 0 ~ value_raw,
      TRUE ~ half_min
    ),
    value_log2 = ifelse(!is.na(value_imp) & value_imp > 0, log2(value_imp), NA_real_)
  )

met_log2_by_sample <- met_long2 %>%
  select(metabolite, sample, value_log2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = value_log2)

safe_write_csv(met_log2_by_sample, file.path(OUTDIR, "02_differential", "metabolite_log2_by_sample.csv"))

# -----------------------------
# 3. differential metabolites
# -----------------------------
msg("Running differential metabolite analysis...")

met_diff_core <- met_long2 %>%
  group_by(metabolite) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x

    sum_tbl <- d %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      summarise(
        n = sum(!is.na(value_log2)),
        mean = mean(value_log2, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = sd(value_log2, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    getv <- function(g, field) {
      x <- sum_tbl %>% filter(group == g) %>% pull({{field}})
      if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else x[1]
    }

    mean_A <- getv("GR", mean); sd_A <- getv("GR", sd); nA <- getv("GR", n)
    mean_B <- getv("MR", mean); sd_B <- getv("MR", sd); nB <- getv("MR", n)
    mean_C <- getv("MR+Phage cocktail", mean); sd_C <- getv("MR+Phage cocktail", sd); nC <- getv("MR+Phage cocktail", n)

    p_overall <- NA_real_
    mse <- NA_real_
    df_res <- NA_real_

    dd <- d %>% filter(!is.na(value_log2))
    if (nrow(dd) >= 6 && length(unique(dd$group)) >= 2) {
      fit <- try(stats::aov(value_log2 ~ group, data = dd), silent = TRUE)
      if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
        s <- summary(fit)[[1]]
        p_overall <- s[["Pr(>F)"]][1]
        mse <- s[["Mean Sq"]][nrow(s)]
        df_res <- s[["Df"]][nrow(s)]
      }
    }

    p_A_vs_B <- lsd_p(mean_A, mean_B, nA, nB, mse, df_res)
    p_C_vs_B <- lsd_p(mean_C, mean_B, nC, nB, mse, df_res)
    p_C_vs_A <- lsd_p(mean_C, mean_A, nC, nA, mse, df_res)

    log2FC_A_vs_B <- mean_A - mean_B
    log2FC_C_vs_B <- mean_C - mean_B
    log2FC_C_vs_A <- mean_C - mean_A

    tibble::tibble(
      p_overall = p_overall,
      mean_A = mean_A, sd_A = sd_A, n_A = nA,
      mean_B = mean_B, sd_B = sd_B, n_B = nB,
      mean_C = mean_C, sd_C = sd_C, n_C = nC,
      log2FC_A_vs_B = log2FC_A_vs_B, p_A_vs_B = p_A_vs_B,
      log2FC_C_vs_B = log2FC_C_vs_B, p_C_vs_B = p_C_vs_B,
      log2FC_C_vs_A = log2FC_C_vs_A, p_C_vs_A = p_C_vs_A
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

met_meta_one <- met_raw %>%
  transmute(
    metabolite = as.character(`Compound Name (nmol/g)`),
    中文名称 = if ("中文名称" %in% colnames(met_raw)) as.character(`中文名称`) else NA_character_,
    CAS = if ("CAS" %in% colnames(met_raw)) as.character(CAS) else NA_character_,
    Formula = if ("Formula" %in% colnames(met_raw)) as.character(Formula) else NA_character_,
    Pubchem.ID = if ("Pubchem.ID" %in% colnames(met_raw)) as.character(`Pubchem.ID`) else NA_character_,
    HMDB = if ("HMDB" %in% colnames(met_raw)) as.character(HMDB) else NA_character_,
    KEGG = if ("KEGG" %in% colnames(met_raw)) as.character(KEGG) else NA_character_,
    Class = if ("Class" %in% colnames(met_raw)) as.character(Class) else NA_character_,
    分类 = if ("分类" %in% colnames(met_raw)) as.character(`分类`) else NA_character_,
    `Average Molecular Weight` = if ("Average Molecular Weight" %in% colnames(met_raw)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Average Molecular Weight`)) else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  distinct()

met_diff <- met_meta_one %>%
  left_join(met_diff_core, by = "metabolite") %>%
  mutate(
    fdr_overall = p.adjust(p_overall, method = "BH"),
    fdr_A_vs_B  = p.adjust(p_A_vs_B, method = "BH"),
    fdr_C_vs_B  = p.adjust(p_C_vs_B, method = "BH"),
    fdr_C_vs_A  = p.adjust(p_C_vs_A, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    AB_sig = !is.na(fdr_A_vs_B) & fdr_A_vs_B < METAB_AB_FDR_CUT,
    CB_sig = !is.na(fdr_C_vs_B) & fdr_C_vs_B < METAB_CB_FDR_CUT,
    venn_region = case_when(
      AB_sig & CB_sig ~ "Shared",
      AB_sig & !CB_sig ~ "GR_vs_MR_only",
      !AB_sig & CB_sig ~ "Phage_vs_MR_only",
      TRUE ~ "Not_selected"
    ),
    order_key = pmax(abs(log2FC_A_vs_B), abs(log2FC_C_vs_B), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(venn_region, desc(order_key), metabolite)

safe_write_csv(met_diff, file.path(OUTDIR, "02_differential", "metabolite_differential_all.csv"))

# -----------------------------
# 4. Venn sets and color map
# -----------------------------
msg("Building Venn sets...")

venn_tbl <- met_diff %>%
  filter(venn_region != "Not_selected") %>%
  mutate(region_order = case_when(
    venn_region == "GR_vs_MR_only" ~ 1L,
    venn_region == "Shared" ~ 2L,
    venn_region == "Phage_vs_MR_only" ~ 3L,
    TRUE ~ 99L
  )) %>%
  arrange(region_order, desc(order_key), metabolite)

# minimal modification:
# - only regions use venn-set colors
# - shared region metabolites use distinct colors
shared_metabolites <- venn_tbl %>%
  filter(venn_region == "Shared") %>%
  pull(metabolite) %>%
  unique()

shared_color_vec <- make_distinct_colors(length(shared_metabolites))
names(shared_color_vec) <- shared_metabolites

color_map_tbl <- venn_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    metabolite,
    venn_region,
    color = case_when(
      venn_region == "GR_vs_MR_only" ~ AONLY_COLOR,
      venn_region == "Phage_vs_MR_only" ~ BONLY_COLOR,
      venn_region == "Shared" ~ shared_color_vec[metabolite],
      TRUE ~ "grey80"
    )
  )

venn_tbl <- venn_tbl %>%
  left_join(color_map_tbl, by = c("metabolite", "venn_region"))

safe_write_csv(venn_tbl, file.path(OUTDIR, "03_venn_sets", "metabolite_venn_assignment_all.csv"))
safe_write_csv(color_map_tbl, file.path(OUTDIR, "03_venn_sets", "metabolite_color_map.csv"))
safe_write_csv(
  venn_tbl %>% filter(venn_region == "GR_vs_MR_only"),
  file.path(OUTDIR, "03_venn_sets", "GR_vs_MR_only.csv")
)
safe_write_csv(
  venn_tbl %>% filter(venn_region == "Shared"),
  file.path(OUTDIR, "03_venn_sets", "shared.csv")
)
safe_write_csv(
  venn_tbl %>% filter(venn_region == "Phage_vs_MR_only"),
  file.path(OUTDIR, "03_venn_sets", "Phage_vs_MR_only.csv")
)

# -----------------------------
# 5. assign angular layout
# -----------------------------
msg("Assigning ring layout...")

venn_A <- venn_tbl %>%
  filter(venn_region == "GR_vs_MR_only") %>%
  arrange(desc(order_key), metabolite)

venn_S <- venn_tbl %>%
  filter(venn_region == "Shared") %>%
  arrange(desc(order_key), metabolite)

venn_B <- venn_tbl %>%
  filter(venn_region == "Phage_vs_MR_only") %>%
  arrange(desc(order_key), metabolite)

venn_A <- assign_angles(venn_A, ANGLE_RANGE_AONLY[1], ANGLE_RANGE_AONLY[2])
venn_S <- assign_angles(venn_S, ANGLE_RANGE_SHARED[1], ANGLE_RANGE_SHARED[2])
venn_B <- assign_angles(venn_B, ANGLE_RANGE_BONLY[1], ANGLE_RANGE_BONLY[2])

plot_layout_tbl <- bind_rows(venn_A, venn_S, venn_B) %>%
  mutate(
    label = metabolite,
    label_wrapped = wrap_name(label, width = 24)
  )

safe_write_csv(plot_layout_tbl, file.path(OUTDIR, "04_plot", "ring_bar_layout.csv"))

# -----------------------------
# 6. build ring polygons
# -----------------------------
msg("Building ring bar polygons...")

max_abs_fc <- max(
  abs(c(plot_layout_tbl$log2FC_A_vs_B, plot_layout_tbl$log2FC_C_vs_B)),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
if (!is.finite(max_abs_fc) || max_abs_fc <= 0) max_abs_fc <- 1

outer_poly <- build_ring_poly(plot_layout_tbl, track = "outer", max_abs_fc = max_abs_fc)
inner_poly <- build_ring_poly(plot_layout_tbl, track = "inner", max_abs_fc = max_abs_fc)

ring_poly_tbl <- bind_rows(outer_poly, inner_poly)

safe_write_csv(ring_poly_tbl, file.path(OUTDIR, "04_plot", "ring_bar_segments.csv"))

# baseline circles for tracks
ring_base_outer <- make_circle_df(0, 0, OUTER_TRACK_BASE, n = 400)
ring_base_inner <- make_circle_df(0, 0, INNER_TRACK_BASE, n = 400)

venn_circle_left  <- make_circle_df(VENN_LEFT_X, VENN_CENTER_Y, VENN_RADIUS, n = 400)
venn_circle_right <- make_circle_df(VENN_RIGHT_X, VENN_CENTER_Y, VENN_RADIUS, n = 400)

# -----------------------------
# 7. plot
# -----------------------------
msg("Plotting Venn + outer ring bars...")

count_Aonly <- sum(plot_layout_tbl$venn_region == "GR_vs_MR_only")
count_Shared <- sum(plot_layout_tbl$venn_region == "Shared")
count_Bonly <- sum(plot_layout_tbl$venn_region == "Phage_vs_MR_only")

fill_values <- setNames(plot_layout_tbl$color, plot_layout_tbl$metabolite)

# legend: only show all shared metabolites
legend_df <- plot_layout_tbl %>%
  filter(venn_region == "Shared") %>%
  distinct(metabolite, label, color) %>%
  arrange(metabolite)

legend_breaks <- legend_df$metabolite
legend_labels <- legend_df$label

subtitle_text <- paste0(
  "Outer track = GR vs MR; inner track = MR+Phage cocktail vs MR. ",
  "Outward = higher in the first group of each comparison; inward = lower. ",
  "Bar length = |log2FC|."
)

p <- ggplot() +
  # venn circles
  geom_path(data = venn_circle_left, aes(x, y),
            color = "#7CAE00", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_path(data = venn_circle_right, aes(x, y),
            color = "#00BFC4", linewidth = 0.8) +

  # translucent fills for circles
  annotate(
    "path",
    x = venn_circle_left$x, y = venn_circle_left$y,
    colour = grDevices::adjustcolor("#7CAE00", alpha.f = 0.85),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  annotate(
    "path",
    x = venn_circle_right$x, y = venn_circle_right$y,
    colour = grDevices::adjustcolor("#00BFC4", alpha.f = 0.85),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # ring baselines
  geom_path(data = ring_base_outer, aes(x, y), color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_path(data = ring_base_inner, aes(x, y), color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.4) +

  # ring polygons
  geom_polygon(
    data = ring_poly_tbl,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = poly_id, fill = metabolite),
    color = NA,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +

  # venn labels
  annotate("text", x = VENN_LEFT_X, y = VENN_RADIUS + 0.22,
           label = "GR vs MR", color = "#4D7E00", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  annotate("text", x = VENN_RIGHT_X, y = VENN_RADIUS + 0.22,
           label = "MR+Phage cocktail vs MR", color = "#008CA0", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +

  annotate("text", x = -0.88, y = 0.02, label = as.character(count_Aonly), size = 7, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x =  0.00, y = 0.02, label = as.character(count_Shared), size = 7, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x =  0.88, y = 0.02, label = as.character(count_Bonly), size = 7, fontface = "bold") +

  annotate("text", x = -0.88, y = -0.22, label = "only", size = 3.8, color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x =  0.00, y = -0.22, label = "shared", size = 3.8, color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x =  0.88, y = -0.22, label = "only", size = 3.8, color = "grey30") +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = fill_values,
    breaks = legend_breaks,
    labels = legend_labels,
    guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-2.35, 2.95), ylim = c(-2.20, 2.20), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Differential metabolite Venn with outer ring bars",
    subtitle = subtitle_text,
    fill = "Shared metabolites"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 16, 12, 16)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(OUTDIR, "04_plot", "metabolite_venn_outer_ringbars.pdf"),
  plot = p, width = 14, height = 10
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(OUTDIR, "04_plot", "metabolite_venn_outer_ringbars.png"),
  plot = p, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300
)

msg("Done.")
msg("Output directory: ", normalizePath(OUTDIR, winslash = "/"))
```

# Panel I

## Fig2I

Final three-group dopamine analysis; the obsolete MR+AFMT group has been removed from this panel.

```{r fig2i, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ============================================================
## Figure 2I: Dopamine, final 3-group version
##
## Three-group plot for Dopamine from the metabolomics quantification table.
##
## Updated plotting rule:
##   - NO significance brackets/connecting lines
##   - Only place significance labels above:
##       GR
##       MR+Phage cocktail
##     to indicate comparison vs MR
##
## Significance labels:
##   ns    : p >= 0.05
##   *     : p < 0.05
##   **    : p < 0.01
##   ***   : p < 0.001
##   ****  : p < 0.0001
##
## Inputs:
##   - Q2.xlsx
##
## Outputs:
##   - per-sample raw data
##   - matched metabolite row info
##   - overall Kruskal-Wallis result
##   - pairwise Wilcoxon results
##   - violin plot PDF/PNG
## ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# -------------------- SETTINGS --------------------
MET_QUANT_FILE <- "Q2.xlsx"
MET_SHEET <- NULL

# exact first, then fallback fuzzy "dopamin"
TARGET_METABOLITE_CANDIDATES <- c("Dopamine", "Dopamin")

OUTDIR  <- "results_Fig2I_Dopamine_3groups"
TAB_DIR <- file.path(OUTDIR, "tables")
PDF_DIR <- file.path(OUTDIR, "figures_pdf")
PNG_DIR <- file.path(OUTDIR, "figures_png")

for (d in c(OUTDIR, TAB_DIR, PDF_DIR, PNG_DIR)) {
  dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
}

GROUP_LEVELS <- c("GR", "MR", "MR+Phage cocktail")
GROUP_COLORS <- c(
  "GR" = "#7CAE00",
  "MR" = "#F8766D",
  "MR+Phage cocktail" = "#00BFC4"
)

POINT_SIZE <- 2.5
POINT_SHAPE <- 16
VIOLIN_ALPHA <- 0.12
VIOLIN_WIDTH <- 0.78
BOX_WIDTH <- 0.18
JITTER_WIDTH <- 0.07

# -------------------- HELPERS --------------------
stopifnot(file.exists(MET_QUANT_FILE))
if (is.null(MET_SHEET)) MET_SHEET <- excel_sheets(MET_QUANT_FILE)[1]

map_group_3 <- function(s) {
  if (str_detect(s, "^A")) return("GR")
  if (str_detect(s, "^B")) return("MR")
  if (str_detect(s, "^C")) return("MR+Phage cocktail")
  return(NA_character_)
}

p_to_label <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("NA")
  if (p < 1e-4) return("****")
  if (p < 1e-3) return("***")
  if (p < 1e-2) return("**")
  if (p < 5e-2) return("*")
  return("ns")
}

safe_wilcox <- function(x, y) {
  out <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(out)) {
    return(list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  list(statistic = unname(out$statistic), p.value = out$p.value)
}

theme_violin_clean <- function() {
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# -------------------- READ INPUT --------------------
met_raw <- read_excel(MET_QUANT_FILE, sheet = MET_SHEET) %>%
  as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE)

sample_cols <- grep("^[ABC][1-5]$", names(met_raw), value = TRUE)
if (length(sample_cols) != 15) {
  stop("Cannot detect 15 sample columns A1..C5 in Q2.xlsx. Found: ",
       paste(sample_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

compound_col <- grep("Compound\\s*Name.*nmol/g", names(met_raw), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
if (is.na(compound_col) || compound_col == "") {
  compound_col <- grep("Compound\\s*Name", names(met_raw), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
}
if (is.na(compound_col) || compound_col == "") {
  stop("Cannot find 'Compound Name (nmol/g)' or 'Compound Name' column.")
}

met_name <- met_raw[[compound_col]] %>%
  as.character() %>%
  str_trim()

# -------------------- MATCH TARGET METABOLITE --------------------
target_hit_exact <- which(tolower(met_name) %in% tolower(TARGET_METABOLITE_CANDIDATES))
if (length(target_hit_exact) == 0) {
  target_hit_exact <- grep("dopamin", met_name, ignore.case = TRUE)
}
if (length(target_hit_exact) == 0) {
  stop("Cannot find Dopamine/Dopamin in Q2.xlsx. Please check the exact metabolite name.")
}

matched_rows <- met_raw[target_hit_exact, , drop = FALSE]
matched_names <- met_name[target_hit_exact]

write_csv(
  tibble(row_index = target_hit_exact, matched_metabolite_name = matched_names),
  file.path(TAB_DIR, "matched_metabolite_rows.csv")
)

# if duplicate matched rows exist, average by sample
dopamine_mat <- matched_rows[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE] %>% as.matrix()
dopamine_mat <- apply(dopamine_mat, 2, function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)))

if (is.null(dim(dopamine_mat))) {
  dopamine_values <- as.numeric(dopamine_mat)
  names(dopamine_values) <- sample_cols
} else {
  dopamine_values <- colMeans(dopamine_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(dopamine_values) <- sample_cols
}

# -------------------- BUILD PER-SAMPLE TABLE --------------------
df <- tibble(
  sample = sample_cols,
  group = factor(vapply(sample_cols, map_group_3, character(1)), levels = GROUP_LEVELS),
  Dopamine = as.numeric(dopamine_values[sample_cols])
) %>%
  arrange(factor(sample, levels = sample_cols))

write_csv(df, file.path(TAB_DIR, "Dopamine_per_sample_raw.csv"))
write_tsv(df, file.path(TAB_DIR, "Dopamine_per_sample_raw.tsv"))

# -------------------- STATS --------------------
kw_p <- kruskal.test(Dopamine ~ group, data = df)$p.value
kw_tbl <- tibble(
  metabolite = "Dopamine",
  test = "Kruskal-Wallis",
  p_value = kw_p
)
write_csv(kw_tbl, file.path(TAB_DIR, "Dopamine_overall_KruskalWallis.csv"))

pairs <- combn(GROUP_LEVELS, 2, simplify = FALSE)
pw_tbl <- lapply(pairs, function(gp) {
  g1 <- gp[1]
  g2 <- gp[2]
  x1 <- df %>% filter(group == g1) %>% pull(Dopamine)
  x2 <- df %>% filter(group == g2) %>% pull(Dopamine)
  wt <- safe_wilcox(x1, x2)

  tibble(
    metabolite = "Dopamine",
    group1 = g1,
    group2 = g2,
    n1 = length(x1),
    n2 = length(x2),
    mean1 = mean(x1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean2 = mean(x2, na.rm = TRUE),
    median1 = median(x1, na.rm = TRUE),
    median2 = median(x2, na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_mean = mean1 - mean2,
    delta_median = median1 - median2,
    statistic_W = as.numeric(wt$statistic),
    p_value_raw = as.numeric(wt$p.value),
    signif_label_raw = p_to_label(wt$p.value)
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

pw_tbl$p_value_BH <- p.adjust(pw_tbl$p_value_raw, method = "BH")

write_csv(pw_tbl, file.path(TAB_DIR, "Dopamine_pairwise_Wilcoxon_rawP_BH.csv"))
write_tsv(pw_tbl, file.path(TAB_DIR, "Dopamine_pairwise_Wilcoxon_rawP_BH.tsv"))

# -------------------- PLOT LABELS --------------------
# Final Figure 2I includes three groups only. Display the two comparisons versus MR.
label_tbl <- bind_rows(
  pw_tbl %>% filter((group1 == "GR" & group2 == "MR") | (group1 == "MR" & group2 == "GR")) %>%
    slice(1) %>% mutate(target_group = "GR"),
  pw_tbl %>% filter((group1 == "MR+Phage cocktail" & group2 == "MR") |
                    (group1 == "MR" & group2 == "MR+Phage cocktail")) %>%
    slice(1) %>% mutate(target_group = "MR+Phage cocktail")
)

y_max <- max(df$Dopamine, na.rm = TRUE)
y_min <- min(df$Dopamine, na.rm = TRUE)
y_range <- y_max - y_min
if (!is.finite(y_range) || y_range <= 0) y_range <- max(abs(y_max), 1)

offset1 <- max(0.08 * y_range, 0.8)
offset2 <- max(0.16 * y_range, 1.6)

label_pos <- tibble(
  target_group = c("GR", "MR+Phage cocktail"),
  x = c(1, 3),
  y = c(
    max(df$Dopamine[df$group == "GR"], na.rm = TRUE) + offset1,
    max(df$Dopamine[df$group == "MR+Phage cocktail"], na.rm = TRUE) + offset2
  )
)

label_tbl <- label_tbl %>%
  left_join(label_pos, by = "target_group")

# -------------------- PLOT --------------------
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = group, y = Dopamine, fill = group, color = group)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = VIOLIN_ALPHA, trim = TRUE, scale = "width", width = VIOLIN_WIDTH, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(width = BOX_WIDTH, outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = JITTER_WIDTH, height = 0),
    size = POINT_SIZE,
    shape = POINT_SHAPE,
    stroke = 0
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_tbl,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = signif_label_raw),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 6,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("GR", "MR", "MR + Phage")) +
  labs(
    title = "Dopamine",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Dopamine (nmol/g)"
  ) +
  theme_violin_clean() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1)
  )

fig_w <- 6.2
fig_h <- 6.0

ggsave(file.path(PDF_DIR, "Dopamine_3groups_vsMR_labelOnly.pdf"), p, width = fig_w, height = fig_h)
ggsave(file.path(PNG_DIR, "Dopamine_3groups_vsMR_labelOnly.png"), p, width = fig_w, height = fig_h, dpi = 300)

message("[DONE] Outputs saved in: ", normalizePath(OUTDIR))

```

# Panel J

## Fig2J

```{r fig2j, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## =========================================================
## Paper-style PCoA (Bray-Curtis & Jaccard) from phyloseq RDS
## + betadisper (per-sample + pairwise Wilcoxon, 3 pairs)
## + PERMANOVA (overall + pairwise, 3 pairs)
## 3-group version: GR / MR / MR+Phage cocktail
## Output folder: ./BetaPCoA_outputs_phyloseq_3groups/
## =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(phyloseq)
  library(vegan)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tibble)
})

rds_file <- "phyloseq_16S.rds"
out_dir  <- "BetaPCoA_outputs_phyloseq_3groups"
if (!file.exists(rds_file)) stop("Missing file: ", rds_file)
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

ps <- readRDS(rds_file)
if (!inherits(ps, "phyloseq")) stop("Input RDS is not a phyloseq object.")

## ---------- 1) OTU/ASV table ----------
otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu <- t(otu)
otu <- otu[rowSums(otu) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(otu) < 2 || ncol(otu) < 3) stop("Too few taxa or samples after filtering.")

## ---------- 2) metadata ----------
if (is.null(sample_data(ps, errorIfNULL = FALSE))) {
  stop("No sample_data found in the phyloseq object. Please add metadata before running.")
}

sd <- tryCatch(
  as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame"),
  error = function(e1) {
    tryCatch(
      data.frame(sample_data(ps)),
      error = function(e2) {
        stop(
          "Failed to convert sample_data to data.frame.\n",
          "Try: sd <- as(sample_data(ps), 'data.frame')\n",
          "Or check your phyloseq version. Original errors:\n",
          e1$message, "\n", e2$message
        )
      }
    )
  }
)

sd$Sample <- rownames(sd)

## auto-detect group column
cand <- colnames(sd)
cand_l <- tolower(cand)
preferred <- c("group", "grp", "treatment", "condition", "class", "phenotype")
hit <- cand[match(preferred, cand_l)]
hit <- hit[!is.na(hit)]
if (length(hit) == 0) {
  writeLines(
    paste("Available sample_data columns:\n", paste(cand, collapse = ", ")),
    con = file.path(out_dir, "sampledata_columns.txt")
  )
  stop("Cannot find a group column. See: ", file.path(out_dir, "sampledata_columns.txt"))
}
group_col <- hit[1]
sd$Group_raw <- trimws(as.character(sd[[group_col]]))

## ---------- 3) normalize group labels ----------
normalize_group <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || x == "") return(NA_character_)
  xx <- tolower(trimws(x))
  xx <- gsub("[ _\\-]+", "", xx)

  if (grepl("afmt", xx)) return("MR+AFMT")
  if (grepl("phage", xx) || grepl("cocktail", xx)) return("MR+Phage cocktail")

  if (xx == "gr") return("GR")
  if (xx == "mr") return("MR")

  if (xx %in% c("mrafmt", "mr+afmt")) return("MR+AFMT")
  if (xx %in% c("mrphagecocktail", "mr+phagecocktail", "mrphage", "mr+phage", "mrcocktail", "mr+cocktail")) {
    return("MR+Phage cocktail")
  }

  if (x %in% c("GR", "MR", "MR+AFMT", "MR+Phage cocktail")) return(x)
  return(x)
}

sd$Group <- vapply(sd$Group_raw, normalize_group, character(1))

map_summary <- sd %>% count(Group_raw, Group, sort = TRUE)
write.csv(map_summary, file.path(out_dir, "group_mapping_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

## keep only samples present in OTU table
sd <- sd %>% filter(Sample %in% colnames(otu))
otu <- otu[, sd$Sample, drop = FALSE]

## keep ONLY the 3 expected groups
keep_levels <- c("GR", "MR", "MR+Phage cocktail")
drop_other <- !(sd$Group %in% keep_levels)
if (any(drop_other)) {
  dropped <- sd[drop_other, c("Sample", "Group_raw", "Group"), drop = FALSE]
  write.csv(dropped, file.path(out_dir, "dropped_samples_other_groups.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  sd <- sd[!drop_other, , drop = FALSE]
  otu <- otu[, sd$Sample, drop = FALSE]
}

drop_na <- is.na(sd$Group)
if (any(drop_na)) {
  dropped <- sd[drop_na, c("Sample", "Group_raw", "Group"), drop = FALSE]
  write.csv(dropped, file.path(out_dir, "dropped_samples_missing_group.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  sd <- sd[!drop_na, , drop = FALSE]
  otu <- otu[, sd$Sample, drop = FALSE]
}

sd$Group <- factor(sd$Group, levels = keep_levels)
sd$Group <- droplevels(sd$Group)

if (nlevels(sd$Group) < 2) stop("After cleaning, <2 groups remain. Check group_mapping_summary.csv")

## ---------- 4) distances ----------
rel <- sweep(otu, 2, colSums(otu), "/")
rel[is.na(rel)] <- 0

bray <- vegdist(t(rel), method = "bray")
pa   <- (otu > 0) * 1
jacc <- vegdist(t(pa), method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)

saveRDS(bray, file.path(out_dir, "distance_bray.rds"))
saveRDS(jacc, file.path(out_dir, "distance_jaccard.rds"))

## ---------- 5) PCoA ----------
run_pcoa <- function(d) {
  cs <- cmdscale(d, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  eig <- cs$eig
  eig_pos <- eig[eig > 0]
  if (length(eig_pos) == 0) {
    var <- c(NA_real_, NA_real_)
  } else {
    var <- eig_pos / sum(eig_pos)
    if (length(var) < 2) var <- c(var, rep(NA_real_, 2 - length(var)))
  }
  coords <- as.data.frame(cs$points)
  colnames(coords) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
  coords$Sample <- rownames(coords)
  list(coords = coords, var = var[1:2])
}

pcoa_bray <- run_pcoa(bray)
pcoa_jacc <- run_pcoa(jacc)

df_bray <- pcoa_bray$coords %>% left_join(sd %>% select(Sample, Group), by = "Sample")
df_jacc <- pcoa_jacc$coords %>% left_join(sd %>% select(Sample, Group), by = "Sample")

write.csv(df_bray, file.path(out_dir, "PCoA_coords_bray.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(df_jacc, file.path(out_dir, "PCoA_coords_jaccard.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

## ---------- 6) plot style ----------
group_colors <- c(
  "GR" = "#7CAE00",
  "MR" = "#F8766D",
  "MR+Phage cocktail" = "#00BFC4"
)

paper_pcoa_plot <- function(df, var2) {
  xlab <- paste0("PCoA1 (", ifelse(is.na(var2[1]), "NA", sprintf("%.1f", 100 * var2[1])), "%)")
  ylab <- paste0("PCoA2 (", ifelse(is.na(var2[2]), "NA", sprintf("%.1f", 100 * var2[2])), "%)")

  df$Group <- factor(df$Group, levels = keep_levels)
  df_ell <- df %>% group_by(Group) %>% filter(n() >= 3) %>% ungroup()

  ggplot(df, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = Group, fill = Group)) +
    stat_ellipse(
      data = df_ell,
      geom = "polygon", type = "t", level = 0.68,
      alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.95) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, color = "Group", fill = "Group") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.6),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.4),
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}

p_bray <- paper_pcoa_plot(df_bray, pcoa_bray$var)
p_jacc <- paper_pcoa_plot(df_jacc, pcoa_jacc$var)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "PCoA_BrayCurtis_paperStyle.pdf"), p_bray, width = 6, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "PCoA_BrayCurtis_paperStyle.png"), p_bray, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "PCoA_Jaccard_paperStyle.pdf"), p_jacc, width = 6, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "PCoA_Jaccard_paperStyle.png"), p_jacc, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

## ---------- 7) betadisper per-sample + pairwise Wilcoxon ----------
pairwise_wilcox <- function(per_sample) {
  lv <- levels(droplevels(per_sample$Group))
  comb <- combn(lv, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  res <- lapply(comb, function(p) {
    d1 <- per_sample$Distance[per_sample$Group == p[1]]
    d2 <- per_sample$Distance[per_sample$Group == p[2]]
    wt <- wilcox.test(d1, d2, exact = FALSE)
    data.frame(
      group1 = p[1], group2 = p[2],
      n1 = length(d1), n2 = length(d2),
      median1 = median(d1, na.rm = TRUE),
      median2 = median(d2, na.rm = TRUE),
      delta_median = median(d1, na.rm = TRUE) - median(d2, na.rm = TRUE),
      stat_W = unname(wt$statistic),
      p_value = wt$p.value
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  res$q_value <- p.adjust(res$p_value, method = "BH")
  res
}

run_betadisper <- function(dist_obj, tag) {
  bd <- betadisper(dist_obj, sd$Group, type = "centroid")

  per_sample <- data.frame(
    Sample   = names(bd$distances),
    Group    = sd$Group[match(names(bd$distances), sd$Sample)],
    Distance = as.numeric(bd$distances)
  )
  per_sample$Group <- droplevels(per_sample$Group)

  write.csv(per_sample, file.path(out_dir, paste0("betadisper_perSample_", tag, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  pw <- pairwise_wilcox(per_sample)
  write.csv(pw, file.path(out_dir, paste0("betadisper_pairwise_Wilcoxon_3pairs_", tag, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  bd_aov <- anova(bd)
  bd_perm <- permutest(bd, permutations = 9999)
  capture.output(bd_aov, bd_perm, file = file.path(out_dir, paste0("betadisper_global_", tag, ".txt")))
}

set.seed(1)
run_betadisper(bray, "bray")
run_betadisper(jacc, "jaccard")

## ---------- 8) PERMANOVA overall + pairwise ----------
run_permanova <- function(dist_obj, tag, permutations = 9999) {
  set.seed(1)
  overall <- adonis2(dist_obj ~ Group, data = sd, permutations = permutations, by = "margin")
  overall_df <- as.data.frame(overall)
  overall_df$term <- rownames(overall_df)
  rownames(overall_df) <- NULL
  write.csv(overall_df, file.path(out_dir, paste0("PERMANOVA_overall_", tag, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  lv <- levels(droplevels(sd$Group))
  comb <- combn(lv, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  pw <- lapply(comb, function(p) {
    keep <- sd$Group %in% p
    sub_sd <- sd[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    sub_dist <- as.dist(as.matrix(dist_obj)[sub_sd$Sample, sub_sd$Sample])

    set.seed(1)
    ad <- adonis2(sub_dist ~ Group, data = sub_sd, permutations = permutations, by = "margin")
    ad_df <- as.data.frame(ad)
    ad_df$term <- rownames(ad_df)
    rownames(ad_df) <- NULL
    g_row <- ad_df %>% filter(term == "Group") %>% slice(1)

    data.frame(
      group1 = p[1], group2 = p[2],
      Df = g_row$Df, R2 = g_row$R2, F = g_row$F,
      p_value = g_row$`Pr(>F)`
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  pw$q_value <- p.adjust(pw$p_value, method = "BH")
  write.csv(pw, file.path(out_dir, paste0("PERMANOVA_pairwise_3pairs_", tag, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

run_permanova(bray, "bray")
run_permanova(jacc, "jaccard")

message("Done. Outputs in: ", normalizePath(out_dir))
message("Group column used: ", group_col)
message("Groups kept: ", paste(levels(sd$Group), collapse = ", "))
```

```{r fig2k, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(phyloseq)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)

# ============================================================
# plot_16S_group_stacked_bars_global_and_Enterococcus_lineage.R
# Purpose:
#   1) Plot group-level stacked barplots for the whole 16S community
#      at 6 taxonomic ranks:
#         Phylum / Class / Order / Family / Genus / Species
#   2) Plot Enterococcus-lineage zoom-in stacked barplots (scheme 1):
#         - Within Enterococcus-containing Phylum -> Class composition
#         - Within Enterococcus-containing Class  -> Order composition
#         - Within Enterococcus-containing Order  -> Family composition
#         - Within Enterococcus-containing Family -> Genus composition
#         - Within Enterococcus genus            -> Species composition
# Notes:
#   - No per-sample barplots. Only group-level summaries are plotted.
#   - Relative abundance is first computed at sample level, then averaged
#     within each group.
#   - Zoom-in lineage plots are renormalized WITHIN the retained parent clade,
#     so each bar sums to 100% inside that parent taxonomic scope.
#   - Low-abundance taxa are collapsed into "Others" for cleaner figures.
# Inputs (working directory):
#   - phyloseq_16S.rds                  [required]
#   - Sample_Metadata_3groups.csv       [optional fallback]
# Outputs:
#   results_16S_group_stacked_bars_scheme1/
#     01_tables/
#     02_plots_pdf/
#     03_plots_png/
# ============================================================

# -----------------------------
# User parameters
# -----------------------------
PHYLOSEQ_RDS <- "phyloseq_16S.rds"
META_CSV     <- "Sample_Metadata_3groups.csv"
OUTDIR       <- "results_16S_group_stacked_bars_scheme1"

GROUP_LEVELS <- c("GR", "MR", "MR+Phage cocktail")
GROUP_COLORS <- c(
  "GR" = "#7CAE00",
  "MR" = "#F8766D",
  "MR+Phage cocktail" = "#00BFC4"
)

GLOBAL_RANKS <- c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
FOCUS_RANKS  <- c("Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
FOCUS_PARENTS <- c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus")

TOP_N_GLOBAL <- c(
  "Phylum"  = 10,
  "Class"   = 12,
  "Order"   = 12,
  "Family"  = 12,
  "Genus"   = 12,
  "Species" = 12
)

TOP_N_FOCUS <- c(
  "Class"   = 10,
  "Order"   = 10,
  "Family"  = 10,
  "Genus"   = 12,
  "Species" = 12
)

PDF_WIDTH  <- 7.2
PDF_HEIGHT <- 4.8
PNG_WIDTH  <- 2200
PNG_HEIGHT <- 1500
PNG_RES    <- 300

OTHERS_LABEL <- "Others"
UNCLASSIFIED_PREFIX <- "Unclassified"

# -----------------------------
# Basic checks and folders
# -----------------------------
stopifnot(file.exists(PHYLOSEQ_RDS))

dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "01_tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "02_plots_pdf"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "03_plots_png"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

message("[1/7] Reading phyloseq object...")
ps <- readRDS(PHYLOSEQ_RDS)
if (!inherits(ps, "phyloseq")) {
  stop("Input file is not a phyloseq object: ", PHYLOSEQ_RDS)
}

# -----------------------------
# Helper functions
# -----------------------------
clean_tax_value <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_trim(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace(x, "^[a-z]__", "")
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NULL", "na", "nan")] <- NA_character_
  x[stringr::str_detect(stringr::str_to_lower(x), "unclassified|uncultured|unknown|metagenome")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

safe_filename <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("[[:space:]]+", "_") %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("[+/\\\\():;,.]", "_") %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("_+", "_")
}

make_palette <- function(labels, others_label = OTHERS_LABEL) {
  labels <- unique(as.character(labels))
  labels_no_others <- setdiff(labels, others_label)
  n <- length(labels_no_others)

  if (n <= 0) {
    pal <- c()
  } else {
    pal <- grDevices::hcl.colors(
      n = n,
      palette = if (n <= 8) "Dark 3" else "Dynamic",
      alpha = 1
    )
    names(pal) <- labels_no_others
  }

  if (others_label %in% labels) {
    pal <- c(pal, setNames("#BDBDBD", others_label))
  }
  pal[labels]
}


phyloseq_df <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "sample_data")) {
    rn <- rownames(x)
    out <- data.frame(unclass(x), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
    if (!is.null(rn)) rownames(out) <- rn
    return(out)
  }

  if (inherits(x, "taxonomyTable")) {
    out <- methods::as(x, "matrix")
    out <- base::as.data.frame(out, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
    return(out)
  }

  if (is.matrix(x)) {
    out <- base::as.data.frame(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
    return(out)
  }

  out <- base::as.data.frame(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  attributes(out) <- attributes(out)[intersect(names(attributes(out)), c("names", "row.names", "class"))]
  class(out) <- "data.frame"
  out
}

find_group_column <- function(meta_df) {
  nms <- colnames(meta_df)
  nms_low <- tolower(nms)
  cand <- c("group", "grp", "treatment", "condition")
  hit <- nms[match(cand, nms_low, nomatch = 0)]
  hit <- hit[hit != ""]
  if (length(hit) > 0) {
    return(hit[1])
  }
  NULL
}

standardize_group <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_trim(x)
  out <- dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("GR", "Good responder", "Good responders") ~ "GR",
    x %in% c("MR", "Moderate responder", "Moderate responders") ~ "MR",
    x %in% c("MR+Phage cocktail", "MR + Phage cocktail", "MR+Phage", "Phage cocktail") ~ "MR+Phage cocktail",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
  out
}

get_sample_metadata <- function(ps, meta_csv = NULL) {
  meta_ps <- phyloseq_df(sample_data(ps))
  meta_ps$sample <- rownames(meta_ps)

  group_col <- find_group_column(meta_ps)
  if (!is.null(group_col)) {
    meta <- data.frame(
      sample = as.character(meta_ps$sample),
      group  = standardize_group(meta_ps[[group_col]]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  } else if (!is.null(meta_csv) && file.exists(meta_csv)) {
    meta_csv_df <- readr::read_csv(meta_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
    meta_csv_df <- base::as.data.frame(meta_csv_df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
    nms_low <- tolower(colnames(meta_csv_df))
    sample_col <- colnames(meta_csv_df)[match("sample", nms_low, nomatch = 0)]
    group_col2 <- colnames(meta_csv_df)[match("group", nms_low, nomatch = 0)]
    if (length(sample_col) == 0 || length(group_col2) == 0) {
      stop("Metadata CSV must contain columns named sample and group.")
    }
    meta <- data.frame(
      sample = as.character(meta_csv_df[[sample_col[1]]]),
      group  = standardize_group(meta_csv_df[[group_col2[1]]]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    stop("Cannot find group information in phyloseq sample_data, and no usable metadata CSV fallback is available.")
  }

  meta <- meta[meta$sample %in% sample_names(ps), , drop = FALSE]
  meta <- meta[meta$group %in% GROUP_LEVELS, , drop = FALSE]
  meta$group <- factor(meta$group, levels = GROUP_LEVELS)

  if (nrow(meta) == 0) {
    stop("No samples retained after matching GROUP_LEVELS. Please check group labels.")
  }

  rownames(meta) <- NULL
  meta
}

get_rank_mapping <- function(ps, wanted_ranks = GLOBAL_RANKS) {
  tt <- phyloseq_df(tax_table(ps))
  tax_cols <- colnames(tt)
  tax_cols_low <- tolower(tax_cols)

  mapped <- sapply(wanted_ranks, function(rk) {
    hit <- tax_cols[match(tolower(rk), tax_cols_low, nomatch = 0)]
    if (length(hit) == 0) NA_character_ else hit[1]
  }, USE.NAMES = TRUE)

  if (any(is.na(mapped))) {
    missing_ranks <- names(mapped)[is.na(mapped)]
    stop(
      "Missing taxonomy ranks in tax_table: ",
      paste(missing_ranks, collapse = ", "),
      "\nAvailable columns: ", paste(tax_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  mapped
}

subset_phyloseq_samples <- function(ps, meta) {
  prune_samples(meta$sample, ps)
}

transform_to_relative <- function(ps) {
  transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) {
    s <- sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (s <= 0) return(x)
    x / s
  })
}

ps_to_long <- function(ps, rank_col, meta, rank_label = NULL) {
  if (is.null(rank_label)) rank_label <- rank_col

  ps_rank <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = rank_col, NArm = FALSE)

  otu <- as(otu_table(ps_rank), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_rank)) {
    otu <- t(otu)
  }

  tt <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rank), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  tt$TaxonID <- rownames(tt)
  tt[[rank_col]] <- clean_tax_value(tt[[rank_col]])
  tt[[rank_col]][is.na(tt[[rank_col]])] <- paste0(UNCLASSIFIED_PREFIX, "_", rank_label)

  df_long <- as.data.frame(otu, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("TaxonID") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-TaxonID, names_to = "sample", values_to = "abundance") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tt[, c("TaxonID", rank_col), drop = FALSE], by = "TaxonID") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(meta, by = "sample")

  names(df_long)[names(df_long) == rank_col] <- "taxon"

  df_long
}

collapse_low_abundance_taxa <- function(df_group, top_n, others_label = OTHERS_LABEL) {
  overall <- df_group %>%
    dplyr::group_by(taxon) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_abundance_all = mean(mean_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_abundance_all), taxon)

  if (nrow(overall) > top_n) {
    keep_taxa <- overall$taxon[seq_len(top_n)]
  } else {
    keep_taxa <- overall$taxon
  }

  out <- df_group %>%
    dplyr::mutate(taxon_plot = ifelse(taxon %in% keep_taxa, taxon, others_label)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(group, taxon_plot) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_abundance = sum(mean_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::rename(taxon = taxon_plot)

  ord <- out %>%
    dplyr::group_by(taxon) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_abundance_all = mean(mean_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_abundance_all), taxon) %>%
    dplyr::pull(taxon)

  out$taxon <- factor(out$taxon, levels = ord)
  out$group <- factor(out$group, levels = GROUP_LEVELS)
  out
}

summarize_group_mean <- function(df_long) {
  df_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(group, taxon) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_abundance = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

make_plot <- function(df_plot, title_text, subtitle_text = NULL, palette = NULL) {
  taxa_levels <- levels(df_plot$taxon)
  if (is.null(palette)) {
    palette <- make_palette(taxa_levels)

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = group, y = mean_abundance, fill = taxon)) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Mean relative abundance",
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#E6E6E6", linewidth = 0.35),
      axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "#4D4D4D", hjust = 0),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.42, "cm"),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.6)
    )

  p
}

save_plot_dual <- function(plot_obj, pdf_file, png_file,
                           pdf_width = PDF_WIDTH, pdf_height = PDF_HEIGHT,
                           png_width = PNG_WIDTH, png_height = PNG_HEIGHT, png_res = PNG_RES) {
  ggsave(pdf_file, plot = plot_obj, width = pdf_width, height = pdf_height, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(png_file, plot = plot_obj, width = png_width, height = png_height, units = "px", dpi = png_res, bg = "white")
}

infer_enterococcus_lineage <- function(ps, rank_map) {
  otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
    otu <- t(otu)
  }
  total_abund <- rowSums(otu, na.rm = TRUE)

  tt <- phyloseq_df(tax_table(ps))
  for (rk in names(rank_map)) {
    tt[[rank_map[[rk]]]] <- clean_tax_value(tt[[rank_map[[rk]]]])
  }

  idx <- which(tt[[rank_map[["Genus"]]]] == "Enterococcus")
  if (length(idx) == 0) {
    stop("Cannot find Genus == 'Enterococcus' in tax_table.")
  }

  choose_dominant <- function(values, weights) {
    keep <- !is.na(values) & values != ""
    values <- values[keep]
    weights <- weights[keep]
    if (length(values) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    agg <- tapply(weights, values, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
    names(which.max(agg))[1]
  }

  lineage <- c(
    Phylum = choose_dominant(tt[idx, rank_map[["Phylum"]]], total_abund[idx]),
    Class  = choose_dominant(tt[idx, rank_map[["Class"]]],  total_abund[idx]),
    Order  = choose_dominant(tt[idx, rank_map[["Order"]]],  total_abund[idx]),
    Family = choose_dominant(tt[idx, rank_map[["Family"]]], total_abund[idx]),
    Genus  = "Enterococcus"
  )

  as.list(lineage)
}

prune_by_parent <- function(ps, rank_col, parent_value) {
  tt <- phyloseq_df(tax_table(ps))
  vals <- clean_tax_value(tt[[rank_col]])
  keep_taxa <- rownames(tt)[which(vals == parent_value)]
  if (length(keep_taxa) == 0) {
    stop("No taxa retained for parent filter: ", rank_col, " == ", parent_value)
  }
  prune_taxa(keep_taxa, ps)
}

run_one_panel <- function(ps_rel, meta, rank_col, rank_label,
                          scope_label, top_n, out_prefix,
                          subtitle_text = NULL) {
  df_long <- ps_to_long(ps_rel, rank_col = rank_col, meta = meta, rank_label = rank_label)

  df_group <- summarize_group_mean(df_long)
  df_plot <- collapse_low_abundance_taxa(df_group, top_n = top_n, others_label = OTHERS_LABEL)

  palette <- make_palette(levels(df_plot$taxon))
  plot_title <- paste0(scope_label, " | ", rank_label)
  p <- make_plot(df_plot, title_text = plot_title, subtitle_text = subtitle_text, palette = palette)

  readr::write_csv(df_long, file.path(OUTDIR, "01_tables", paste0(out_prefix, "__per_sample_long.csv")))
  readr::write_csv(df_group, file.path(OUTDIR, "01_tables", paste0(out_prefix, "__group_mean_full.csv")))
  readr::write_csv(
    df_plot %>% dplyr::mutate(taxon = as.character(taxon)),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "01_tables", paste0(out_prefix, "__group_mean_plotted.csv"))
  )

  save_plot_dual(
    p,
    pdf_file = file.path(OUTDIR, "02_plots_pdf", paste0(out_prefix, ".pdf")),
    png_file = file.path(OUTDIR, "03_plots_png", paste0(out_prefix, ".png"))
  )

  p
}

# -----------------------------
# Prepare phyloseq + metadata
# -----------------------------
message("[2/7] Preparing metadata and checking taxonomy ranks...")
rank_map <- get_rank_mapping(ps, GLOBAL_RANKS)
meta <- get_sample_metadata(ps, meta_csv = META_CSV)
ps <- subset_phyloseq_samples(ps, meta)

sample_data(ps)$group <- factor(meta$group[match(sample_names(ps), meta$sample)], levels = GROUP_LEVELS)

meta_out <- data.frame(
  sample = sample_names(ps),
  group = as.character(sample_data(ps)$group),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
readr::write_csv(meta_out, file.path(OUTDIR, "01_tables", "samples_used_and_groups.csv"))

# -----------------------------
# Whole-community plots
# -----------------------------
message("[3/7] Building whole-community relative-abundance panels...")
ps_rel_global <- transform_to_relative(ps)

plots_global <- list()
for (rk in GLOBAL_RANKS) {
  rk_col <- rank_map[[rk]]
  out_prefix <- paste0("global__", safe_filename(rk))

  plots_global[[rk]] <- run_one_panel(
    ps_rel = ps_rel_global,
    meta = meta,
    rank_col = rk_col,
    rank_label = rk,
    scope_label = "Whole community",
    top_n = unname(TOP_N_GLOBAL[[rk]]),
    out_prefix = out_prefix,
    subtitle_text = "Sample-level relative abundance averaged within each group"
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Infer Enterococcus lineage
# -----------------------------
message("[4/7] Inferring Enterococcus lineage...")
lineage <- infer_enterococcus_lineage(ps_rel_global, rank_map = rank_map)
lineage_df <- data.frame(
  rank = names(lineage),
  value = unlist(lineage, use.names = FALSE),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
readr::write_csv(lineage_df, file.path(OUTDIR, "01_tables", "Enterococcus_inferred_lineage.csv"))

# -----------------------------
# Focused Enterococcus-lineage plots
# -----------------------------
message("[5/7] Building Enterococcus-lineage zoom-in panels...")
plots_focus <- list()

for (i in seq_along(FOCUS_RANKS)) {
  child_rank <- FOCUS_RANKS[i]
  parent_rank <- FOCUS_PARENTS[i]

  parent_value <- unname(lineage[[parent_rank]])
  if (is.na(parent_value) || parent_value == "") {
    warning("Skipping focus plot because inferred parent is missing: ", parent_rank)
    next
  }

  parent_col <- rank_map[[parent_rank]]
  child_col  <- rank_map[[child_rank]]

  ps_parent <- prune_by_parent(ps, rank_col = parent_col, parent_value = parent_value)
  ps_parent_rel <- transform_to_relative(ps_parent)

  scope_label <- paste0("Within ", parent_rank, ": ", parent_value)
  out_prefix <- paste0(
    "focus__within_", safe_filename(parent_rank), "_", safe_filename(parent_value),
    "__", safe_filename(child_rank)
  )

  subtitle_text <- paste0(
    "Renormalized within ", parent_rank, " = ", parent_value,
    "; sample-level relative abundance averaged within each group"
  )

  plots_focus[[child_rank]] <- run_one_panel(
    ps_rel = ps_parent_rel,
    meta = meta,
    rank_col = child_col,
    rank_label = child_rank,
    scope_label = scope_label,
    top_n = unname(TOP_N_FOCUS[[child_rank]]),
    out_prefix = out_prefix,
    subtitle_text = subtitle_text
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Multi-page summary PDFs
# -----------------------------
message("[6/7] Exporting multi-page summary PDFs...")
pdf(file.path(OUTDIR, "02_plots_pdf", "all_global_panels_multipage.pdf"), width = PDF_WIDTH, height = PDF_HEIGHT, onefile = TRUE)
for (nm in names(plots_global)) print(plots_global[[nm]])
dev.off()

pdf(file.path(OUTDIR, "02_plots_pdf", "all_Enterococcus_lineage_panels_multipage.pdf"), width = PDF_WIDTH, height = PDF_HEIGHT, onefile = TRUE)
for (nm in names(plots_focus)) print(plots_focus[[nm]])
dev.off()

# -----------------------------
# Done
# -----------------------------
message("[7/7] Done.")
message("Output directory: ", OUTDIR)
message("Tables: ", file.path(OUTDIR, "01_tables"))
message("PDF plots: ", file.path(OUTDIR, "02_plots_pdf"))
message("PNG plots: ", file.path(OUTDIR, "03_plots_png"))
message("Inferred Enterococcus lineage: ", paste(lineage_df$rank, lineage_df$value, sep = "=", collapse = " ; "))

```

# Panel L

## Fig2L

```{r fig2l, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# ============================================================
# 3-group 16S species Venn + outer ring bars from raw data
# - 16S raw table: featuretable_no_singletons.txt
# - metadata:      Sample_Metadata_3groups.csv
#
# Groups:
#   A = GR
#   B = MR
#   C = MR+Phage cocktail
#
# Main outputs:
#   results_3group_16S_species_venn_ringbars/
#     01_input_checks/
#     02_species_differential/
#     03_venn_sets/
#     04_plot/
#
# Statistical framework is aligned to the species-side filtering/differential
# logic used in run_3group_species_metabolite_sankey_from_raw_v11...:
#   - species-level aggregation from raw feature table
#   - prevalence >= 0.10
#   - mean relative abundance >= 1e-4
#   - CLR with pseudocount = 0.5
#   - Wilcoxon rank-sum tests
#   - BH-FDR
#   - Venn membership based on intersection logic across:
#       * GR vs MR
#       * MR+Phage cocktail vs MR
#
# Plot design:
#   - Center: 2-set Venn (GR vs MR ; MR+Phage cocktail vs MR)
#   - Outer ring bars:
#       outer track = GR vs MR
#       inner track = MR+Phage cocktail vs MR
#   - only regions: use venn-set colors
#   - shared region: each shared species gets its own distinct color
#   - Outward  = higher in GR / MR+Phage cocktail
#   - Inward   = higher in MR
#   - Bar length = |CLR mean difference|
# ============================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# -----------------------------
# user parameters
# -----------------------------
FEATURE_TABLE_FILE <- "featuretable_no_singletons.txt"
METADATA_FILE      <- "Sample_Metadata_3groups.csv"

OUTDIR <- "results_3group_16S_species_venn_ringbars"

GROUP_LEVELS <- c("GR", "MR", "MR+Phage cocktail")

# species prefilter (same as Sankey script)
SPECIES_PREVALENCE_MIN <- 0.10
SPECIES_MEAN_REL_MIN   <- 1e-04
SPECIES_CLR_PSEUDOCOUNT <- 0.5

# venn membership thresholds (same as Sankey species side)
SPECIES_AB_FDR_CUT <- 0.10   # GR vs MR
SPECIES_CB_FDR_CUT <- 0.10   # MR+Phage cocktail vs MR

# only-region colors = venn circle colors
AONLY_COLOR <- "#7CAE00"   # GR vs MR only
BONLY_COLOR <- "#00BFC4"   # MR+Phage cocktail vs MR only

# bar length scaling
BAR_MAX_LEN_OUTER <- 0.32
BAR_MAX_LEN_INNER <- 0.24

# angular ranges (degrees) for the 3 Venn regions around the outside
# left = A only ; top = shared ; right = B only
ANGLE_RANGE_AONLY  <- c(140, 240)
ANGLE_RANGE_SHARED <- c(55, 125)
ANGLE_RANGE_BONLY  <- c(-40, 40)

# plot geometry
VENN_LEFT_X   <- -0.48
VENN_RIGHT_X  <-  0.48
VENN_CENTER_Y <-  0.00
VENN_RADIUS   <-  0.78

OUTER_TRACK_BASE <- 1.72
INNER_TRACK_BASE <- 1.48

POLY_N <- 45

# -----------------------------
# helpers
# -----------------------------
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "01_input_checks"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "02_species_differential"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "03_venn_sets"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "04_plot"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

msg <- function(...) {
  cat(sprintf("[%s] ", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")), ..., "\n")
}

stop_if_missing_file <- function(x) {
  if (!file.exists(x)) stop("File not found: ", x)
}

safe_write_csv <- function(x, file) {
  readr::write_csv(x, file, na = "")
}

clean_taxon_label <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-\\+\\.]", "_")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "_+", "_")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "^_|_$", "")
  x
}

parse_tax_rank <- function(tax_vec, prefix) {
  out <- vapply(strsplit(as.character(tax_vec), ";\\s*"), function(parts) {
    hit <- parts[startsWith(parts, prefix)]
    if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    sub(paste0("^", prefix), "", hit[1])
  }, character(1))
  out[out %in% c("", NA)] <- NA_character_
  out
}

make_species_label <- function(species, genus) {
  raw <- ifelse(!is.na(species) &
                  !species %in% c(
                    "uncultured_bacterium", "unclassified_bacterium",
                    "uncultured", "unclassified", "metagenome"
                  ),
                species,
                ifelse(!is.na(genus) &
                         !genus %in% c("uncultured", "unclassified", "Ambiguous_taxa"),
                       paste0("unclassified_", genus),
                       "unclassified_species"))
  clean_taxon_label(raw)
}

clr_matrix <- function(count_mat, pseudocount = 0.5) {
  x <- as.matrix(count_mat)
  x <- x + pseudocount
  logx <- log(x)
  sweep(logx, 2, colMeans(logx), "-")
}

wilcox_p <- function(x, g, g1, g2) {
  idx <- g %in% c(g1, g2) & !is.na(x)
  if (sum(idx) < 4) return(NA_real_)
  x1 <- x[idx & g == g1]
  x2 <- x[idx & g == g2]
  if (length(x1) < 2 || length(x2) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  stats::wilcox.test(x1, x2, exact = FALSE)$p.value
}

safe_neglog10 <- function(x, floor = 1e-300) {
  -log10(pmax(x, floor, na.rm = TRUE))
}

rescale_range <- function(x, to = c(0, 1), from = NULL) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  if (length(x) == 0) return(numeric(0))
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(rep(mean(to), length(x)))
  if (is.null(from)) from <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!all(is.finite(from)) || diff(from) == 0) return(rep(mean(to), length(x)))
  scaled <- (x - from[1]) / diff(from)
  to[1] + scaled * diff(to)
}

make_distinct_colors <- function(n) {
  if (n <= 0) return(character(0))

  # Wider visual separation than a simple single-pass hue wheel:
  # 1) spread hues around the full circle
  # 2) interleave odd/even positions so adjacent legend items are less similar
  # 3) alternate luminance/chroma to further increase distinguishability
  hues <- seq(15, 375, length.out = n + 1)[1:n]
  idx  <- c(seq(1, n, by = 2), seq(2, n, by = 2))
  hues <- hues[idx]

  l_vals <- rep(c(56, 72, 63), length.out = n)
  c_vals <- rep(c(110, 90, 100), length.out = n)

  grDevices::hcl(h = hues, c = c_vals, l = l_vals, fixup = TRUE)
}

make_circle_df <- function(cx, cy, r, n = 360) {
  theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n)
  tibble(
    x = cx + r * cos(theta),
    y = cy + r * sin(theta)
  )
}

sector_polygon <- function(theta1_deg, theta2_deg, r_inner, r_outer, n = 40) {
  th1 <- theta1_deg * pi / 180
  th2 <- theta2_deg * pi / 180
  th_outer <- seq(th1, th2, length.out = n)
  th_inner <- seq(th2, th1, length.out = n)

  tibble(
    x = c(r_outer * cos(th_outer), r_inner * cos(th_inner)),
    y = c(r_outer * sin(th_outer), r_inner * sin(th_inner))
  )
}

assign_angles <- function(df_region, theta_start_deg, theta_end_deg) {
  n <- nrow(df_region)
  if (n == 0) return(df_region)

  if (n == 1) {
    center_deg <- mean(c(theta_start_deg, theta_end_deg))
    width_deg  <- min(abs(theta_end_deg - theta_start_deg) * 0.55, 10)
    df_region$theta_center_deg <- center_deg
    df_region$theta_min_deg <- center_deg - width_deg / 2
    df_region$theta_max_deg <- center_deg + width_deg / 2
    return(df_region)
  }

  centers <- seq(theta_start_deg, theta_end_deg, length.out = n + 2)[2:(n + 1)]
  gap <- abs(diff(range(theta_start_deg, theta_end_deg))) / (n + 1)
  width_deg <- min(gap * 0.65, 9)

  df_region$theta_center_deg <- centers
  df_region$theta_min_deg <- centers - width_deg / 2
  df_region$theta_max_deg <- centers + width_deg / 2
  df_region
}

build_ring_poly <- function(plot_tbl, track = c("outer", "inner"), max_abs_fc) {
  track <- match.arg(track)

  if (nrow(plot_tbl) == 0) return(tibble())

  base_radius <- if (track == "outer") OUTER_TRACK_BASE else INNER_TRACK_BASE
  max_len     <- if (track == "outer") BAR_MAX_LEN_OUTER else BAR_MAX_LEN_INNER
  comp_col    <- if (track == "outer") "clr_diff_A_vs_B" else "clr_diff_C_vs_B"

  df_use <- plot_tbl %>%
    filter(
      (track == "outer" & venn_region %in% c("GR_vs_MR_only", "Shared")) |
        (track == "inner" & venn_region %in% c("Phage_vs_MR_only", "Shared"))
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      comp_value = .data[[comp_col]],
      comp_abs   = abs(comp_value),
      bar_len    = ifelse(
        is.na(comp_abs) | max_abs_fc <= 0,
        0,
        comp_abs / max_abs_fc * max_len
      ),
      direction  = case_when(
        is.na(comp_value) ~ "missing",
        comp_value > 0 ~ "outward",
        comp_value < 0 ~ "inward",
        TRUE ~ "flat"
      )
    )

  poly_list <- vector("list", nrow(df_use))
  idx <- 1L

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_use))) {
    rr <- df_use[i, ]

    if (is.na(rr$bar_len) || rr$bar_len <= 0) next

    if (rr$direction == "outward") {
      r_in  <- base_radius
      r_out <- base_radius + rr$bar_len
    } else if (rr$direction == "inward") {
      r_in  <- base_radius - rr$bar_len
      r_out <- base_radius
    } else {
      next
    }

    poly_df <- sector_polygon(
      theta1_deg = rr$theta_min_deg,
      theta2_deg = rr$theta_max_deg,
      r_inner = r_in,
      r_outer = r_out,
      n = POLY_N
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        species = rr$species,
        region = rr$venn_region,
        comparison = ifelse(track == "outer", "GR vs MR", "MR+Phage cocktail vs MR"),
        direction = rr$direction,
        value = rr$comp_value,
        abs_value = rr$comp_abs,
        color = rr$color,
        poly_id = paste(track, rr$species, sep = "__")
      )

    poly_list[[idx]] <- poly_df
    idx <- idx + 1L
  }

  bind_rows(poly_list)
}

wrap_name <- function(x, width = 28) {
  stringr::str_wrap(x, width = width)
}

# -----------------------------
# 1. read metadata
# -----------------------------
msg("Reading metadata...")
stop_if_missing_file(METADATA_FILE)
meta <- readr::read_csv(METADATA_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)

required_meta_cols <- c("sample", "group")
if (!all(required_meta_cols %in% colnames(meta))) {
  stop("Metadata must contain columns: sample, group")
}

meta <- meta %>%
  filter(group %in% GROUP_LEVELS) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = GROUP_LEVELS)) %>%
  arrange(group, sample)

samples_keep <- meta$sample
safe_write_csv(meta, file.path(OUTDIR, "01_input_checks", "metadata_used.csv"))
msg("Metadata samples: ", length(samples_keep))

# -----------------------------
# 2. read 16S feature table and build species matrix
# -----------------------------
msg("Reading 16S feature table...")
stop_if_missing_file(FEATURE_TABLE_FILE)
ft <- readr::read_tsv(FEATURE_TABLE_FILE, skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)

required_ft_cols <- c("#FeatureID", samples_keep, "taxonomy")
if (!all(required_ft_cols %in% colnames(ft))) {
  stop("16S feature table is missing required columns.")
}

ft_use <- ft %>%
  select(`#FeatureID`, all_of(samples_keep), taxonomy)

ft_tax <- ft_use %>%
  mutate(
    species = parse_tax_rank(taxonomy, "s__"),
    genus   = parse_tax_rank(taxonomy, "g__"),
    species_label = make_species_label(species, genus)
  )

safe_write_csv(
  ft_tax %>% select(`#FeatureID`, taxonomy, genus, species, species_label),
  file.path(OUTDIR, "01_input_checks", "feature_taxonomy_parsed.csv")
)

species_count <- ft_tax %>%
  select(species_label, all_of(samples_keep)) %>%
  group_by(species_label) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(samples_keep), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

species_count_mat <- species_count %>%
  column_to_rownames("species_label") %>%
  as.matrix()

species_relab_mat <- sweep(species_count_mat, 2, colSums(species_count_mat), "/")
species_prev <- rowMeans(species_relab_mat > 0)
species_mean_relab <- rowMeans(species_relab_mat)

species_filter_tbl <- tibble(
  species = rownames(species_relab_mat),
  prevalence = species_prev,
  mean_relab = species_mean_relab,
  keep = prevalence >= SPECIES_PREVALENCE_MIN & mean_relab >= SPECIES_MEAN_REL_MIN
)

safe_write_csv(species_filter_tbl, file.path(OUTDIR, "02_species_differential", "species_filter_table.csv"))

species_keep <- species_filter_tbl %>% filter(keep) %>% pull(species)
species_count_filt <- species_count_mat[species_keep, , drop = FALSE]
species_relab_filt <- species_relab_mat[species_keep, , drop = FALSE]
species_clr_filt <- clr_matrix(species_count_filt, pseudocount = SPECIES_CLR_PSEUDOCOUNT)

safe_write_csv(
  as.data.frame(species_relab_filt) %>% rownames_to_column("species"),
  file.path(OUTDIR, "02_species_differential", "species_relative_abundance_by_sample.csv")
)
safe_write_csv(
  as.data.frame(species_clr_filt) %>% rownames_to_column("species"),
  file.path(OUTDIR, "02_species_differential", "species_clr_by_sample.csv")
)

msg("Species retained after filtering: ", nrow(species_clr_filt))

# -----------------------------
# 3. differential species (same framework as Sankey species side)
# -----------------------------
msg("Running differential species analysis...")

species_long <- as.data.frame(species_clr_filt) %>%
  rownames_to_column("species") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(samples_keep), names_to = "sample", values_to = "clr") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "sample")

species_diff <- species_long %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x

    sum_tbl <- d %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      summarise(
        n = sum(!is.na(clr)),
        mean = mean(clr, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = sd(clr, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = median(clr, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    getv <- function(g, field) {
      x <- sum_tbl %>% filter(group == g) %>% pull({{ field }})
      if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else x[1]
    }

    mean_A <- getv("GR", mean)
    mean_B <- getv("MR", mean)
    mean_C <- getv("MR+Phage cocktail", mean)
    sd_A <- getv("GR", sd)
    sd_B <- getv("MR", sd)
    sd_C <- getv("MR+Phage cocktail", sd)
    med_A <- getv("GR", median)
    med_B <- getv("MR", median)
    med_C <- getv("MR+Phage cocktail", median)

    p_A_vs_B <- wilcox_p(d$clr, d$group, "GR", "MR")
    p_C_vs_B <- wilcox_p(d$clr, d$group, "MR+Phage cocktail", "MR")
    p_C_vs_A <- wilcox_p(d$clr, d$group, "MR+Phage cocktail", "GR")

    clr_diff_A_vs_B <- mean_A - mean_B
    clr_diff_C_vs_B <- mean_C - mean_B
    clr_diff_C_vs_A <- mean_C - mean_A

    tibble(
      mean_A = mean_A, sd_A = sd_A, median_A = med_A,
      mean_B = mean_B, sd_B = sd_B, median_B = med_B,
      mean_C = mean_C, sd_C = sd_C, median_C = med_C,
      clr_diff_A_vs_B = clr_diff_A_vs_B, p_A_vs_B = p_A_vs_B,
      clr_diff_C_vs_B = clr_diff_C_vs_B, p_C_vs_B = p_C_vs_B,
      clr_diff_C_vs_A = clr_diff_C_vs_A, p_C_vs_A = p_C_vs_A,
      direction_AB = case_when(
        is.na(clr_diff_A_vs_B) ~ NA_character_,
        clr_diff_A_vs_B > 0 ~ "Higher_in_GR",
        clr_diff_A_vs_B < 0 ~ "Higher_in_MR",
        TRUE ~ "Zero"
      ),
      direction_CB = case_when(
        is.na(clr_diff_C_vs_B) ~ NA_character_,
        clr_diff_C_vs_B > 0 ~ "Higher_in_MR+Phage cocktail",
        clr_diff_C_vs_B < 0 ~ "Higher_in_MR",
        TRUE ~ "Zero"
      )
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    fdr_A_vs_B = p.adjust(p_A_vs_B, method = "BH"),
    fdr_C_vs_B = p.adjust(p_C_vs_B, method = "BH"),
    fdr_C_vs_A = p.adjust(p_C_vs_A, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    AB_sig = !is.na(fdr_A_vs_B) & fdr_A_vs_B < SPECIES_AB_FDR_CUT,
    CB_sig = !is.na(fdr_C_vs_B) & fdr_C_vs_B < SPECIES_CB_FDR_CUT,
    venn_region = case_when(
      AB_sig & CB_sig ~ "Shared",
      AB_sig & !CB_sig ~ "GR_vs_MR_only",
      !AB_sig & CB_sig ~ "Phage_vs_MR_only",
      TRUE ~ "Not_selected"
    ),
    order_key = pmax(abs(clr_diff_A_vs_B), abs(clr_diff_C_vs_B), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(venn_region, desc(order_key), species)

safe_write_csv(species_diff, file.path(OUTDIR, "02_species_differential", "species_differential_all.csv"))

# -----------------------------
# 4. Venn sets and color map
# -----------------------------
msg("Building Venn sets...")

venn_tbl <- species_diff %>%
  filter(venn_region != "Not_selected") %>%
  mutate(region_order = case_when(
    venn_region == "GR_vs_MR_only" ~ 1L,
    venn_region == "Shared" ~ 2L,
    venn_region == "Phage_vs_MR_only" ~ 3L,
    TRUE ~ 99L
  )) %>%

msg("Assigning ring layout...")

venn_A <- venn_tbl %>%

venn_S <- venn_tbl %>%

venn_B <- venn_tbl %>%

venn_A <- assign_angles(venn_A, ANGLE_RANGE_AONLY[1], ANGLE_RANGE_AONLY[2])

# Shared colors are assigned AFTER angular layout so that:

shared_species_order <- venn_S %>%

shared_color_vec <- make_distinct_colors(length(shared_species_order))
names(shared_color_vec) <- shared_species_order

color_map_tbl <- bind_rows(

)

venn_tbl <- venn_tbl %>%
  left_join(
    color_map_tbl %>% select(species, venn_region, theta_center_deg, color),
    by = c("species", "venn_region")
  )

venn_A <- venn_A %>%
  left_join(color_map_tbl %>% select(species, venn_region, color),
            by = c("species", "venn_region"))

venn_S <- venn_S %>%
  left_join(color_map_tbl %>% select(species, venn_region, color),
            by = c("species", "venn_region"))

venn_B <- venn_B %>%
  left_join(color_map_tbl %>% select(species, venn_region, color),
            by = c("species", "venn_region"))

safe_write_csv(venn_tbl, file.path(OUTDIR, "03_venn_sets", "species_venn_assignment_all.csv"))
safe_write_csv(color_map_tbl, file.path(OUTDIR, "03_venn_sets", "species_color_map.csv"))
safe_write_csv(
  venn_tbl %>% filter(venn_region == "GR_vs_MR_only"),

safe_write_csv(

plot_layout_tbl <- bind_rows(venn_A, venn_S, venn_B) %>%

# -----------------------------

msg("Building ring bar polygons...")

max_abs_fc <- max(
```
